name: @workspace/innovation-club-desktop
description: Windows desktop wrapper for the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Club website

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "pnpm run web:dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:19986 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:19986 electron ."
scripts.web:dev: cross-env PORT=19986 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/innovation-club run dev
scripts.build:web: cross-env PORT=19986 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/innovation-club run build
